spec2def(xinput1_2.dll xinput1_2.spec)

# xinput1_2.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xinput1_2-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(xinput1_2_shims OBJECT xinput1_2_main.c)
target_link_libraries(xinput1_2_shims PRIVATE libxinput1_3 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
set_wine_module(xinput1_2_shims)
add_cargo_module(xinput1_2 xinput1_2-cargo xinput1_2.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xinput1_2_shims psdk)
